patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with distinct background treatments (gradients, abstract art, product shots) create a visually rich and immersive experience, often with content centered or left-aligned within a clear content width.

Prominent, large serif headings are used for key section titles and the brand logo, providing strong visual anchors and a sense of gravitas, contrasting with clean sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
A sophisticated palette of deep, rich dark gradients and off-white backgrounds delineates sections, punctuated by vibrant, illustrative accent colors within abstract graphics and product imagery.
Sections reveal with a subtle slide-up and fade-in effect as they enter the viewport, often accompanied by a background parallax or transformation, creating a dynamic and engaging scroll experience.
A persistent sticky navigation bar remains fixed at the top, providing constant access to site navigation after an initial dismissible top banner scrolls out of view.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed using a scroll-triggered animation system (likely `locomotive-scroll`), where entire content blocks slide up and fade in as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, guided scrolling experience. Backgrounds often exhibit a subtle parallax effect, moving at a different rate than foreground content.
The main navigation bar is sticky, remaining at the top of the page after an initial dismissible banner is scrolled past, providing constant access to site navigation.
The hero section utilizes a `video-hero` technique where the background appears to be a subtle animation or video, enhancing the initial visual impact.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, complemented by clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, functional UI text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields; otherwise sharp corners for content blocks.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in hero and key feature sections, transitioning to a more balanced density in content and footer areas.

standout: The site effectively blends sophisticated, large-scale serif typography for brand and section titles with modern sans-serif for readability. Its distinctive use of scroll-triggered reveals and subtle background parallax creates a dynamic yet polished user experience, making content feel premium and engaging rather than static.
